subject: Semester End Final Examination Timetable & Hall Ticket Released
snippet: Mandatory final examinations schedule is finalized. Download your hall tickets before the exam session commences.
body:
Dear Students,

The semester end final theory and laboratory examinations schedule has been published on the student portal.

Please note:
1. Hall ticket download is mandatory.
2. No candidate will be admitted to the examination hall without valid identity proof.
3. The exams begin promptly from next Monday at 09:30 AM.

Exam Cell

subject: Annual Technical Hackathon & AI Project Fest 2026
snippet: Workshop registration deadline is this Friday. Cash prizes up to INR 1,50,000 for winning teams.
body:
Greetings Innovators!

The Department of Computer Engineering is hosting the annual 36-hour National Level Hackathon and Project Exhibition. Registration is open for teams of 2 to 4 members. Workshops on Generative AI and Cloud Computing will also take place during the event.

subject: Campus Placement Drive: Google & Microsoft Internship Hiring
snippet: Shortlisted candidates for Google and Microsoft internship interview must submit updated resume today.
body: Congratulations to all students shortlisted for the final interview rounds in the ongoing campus recruitment drive! Please ensure your latest resume and portfolio link are submitted to the placement cell portal by 5:00 PM today.
